answer_1.quote: We propose that LLMs offer an avenue for scaling the targeted nuanced qualitative research methods to larger data sets, i.e., conducting inductive coding at scale.
answer_1.outputs: labels and hierarchical themes from text segments

answer_2.quote: We calculate theme-level and segment-level metrics which are modified precision and recall scores.

answer_4.quote: we further conduct a human evaluation by recruiting two of the original annotators of Astro to manually compare the generated themes with the human themes.
answer_4.guideline: We provide outputs from three runs each of TopicGPT and HICode and ask annotators to score each pair of gold and generated themes with 0.5 if the gold theme is partially recovered by the model (e.g., gold theme is a superset of the model theme or vice versa) and 1 if the gold theme exactly matches the generated theme.
